description: Trim or extend one finished clip by moving its start and/or end, then re-render it. Offsets are in seconds, relative to the clip's ORIGINAL bounds (two calls do not add up): positive extends (start earlier / end later), negative trims. The result must last 3-180 s and stay inside the source video. Extending re-cuts from the source, which Katto keeps 7 days: after that only trimming works (410). Captions for an extended part come from words Katto already timed or the transcript sentence. Does NOT use video quota; the original clip is kept. Not idempotent: each call starts a new render. Returns { rerender_id, status_url, start_seconds, end_seconds, duration_seconds, extended }; poll katto_get_rerender for the new clip_url.

end_offset_seconds.description: Seconds to move the END: positive ends later (extends), negative ends earlier (trims). Relative to the clip's original end.

start_offset_seconds.description: Seconds to move the START: positive starts earlier (extends), negative starts later (trims). Relative to the clip's original start.

name: katto_adjust_clip
